faq.q: What is the origin of Azeez?
faq.a: Azeez is associated with Arabic. ʿAzīz ('mighty, powerful, dear'); al-ʿAzīz is one of the divine names.
Yes — the underlying form عزيز is Arabic.
Azeez can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Azeez should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. العزيز is a name of God in the Qur'an

faq.a: Romanization variants include Azeez, azeez. Script forms are عزيز, عزیز, अज़ीज़.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
